newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT-Molinos downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Molinos downgraded to hold.

text.p: Flemings Research said Monday it had downgraded Argentine food firm Molinos Rio de la Plata SA to hold from long-term buy.

- The bank said Molinos' competitive advantages made its long-term outlook positive, but "in the shorter term, pressure on margins could, once again, drive the company's results before market estimates."
- "The stock has outperformed the market by 82 percent and 13.3 percent in absolute and relative terms, respectively, since we initiated coverage on September 15, 1995."

- Flemings pointed out a 3.4 percent drop in first quarter net sales, a shift from Molinos' premium brands into its lower quality ones, and increased competition putting downward pressure on some product margins.
